mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_feature_daily (stock_code, base_date, ma5, ma20, rsi14, macd, bollinger_upper, bollinger_lower, feature_version) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{baseDate}, #{ma5}, #{ma20}, #{rsi14}, #{macd}, #{bollingerUpper}, #{bollingerLower}, #{featureVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ma5 = VALUES(ma5), ma20 = VALUES(ma20), rsi14 = VALUES(rsi14), macd = VALUES(macd), bollinger_upper = VALUES(bollinger_upper), bollinger_lower = VALUES(bollinger_lower), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
